caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with module VMware OpenSSL FIPS Object Module validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #2839 operating in FIPS mode
description: Powering IPsec encryption and integrity in NSX Edge and NSX Controller is the VMware's Linux Cryptographic Module. The Tunnel mode of the Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) protocol performed by an IPsec Service kernel stack, such as NETKEY, utilizes the VMware's Linux Cryptographic Module to encrypt, decrypt, and perform integrity checks on data entering and exiting the NSX Edge virtual appliance.
